Ghana’s Black Challenge have stepped up preparations for their Round of 16 clash against the USA at the Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico, scheduled for Wednesday, November 18.
The Black Challenge booked their place in the knockout stage after thrashing Iraq 6-0 in their final Group D match to finish second with four points.
Head coach Richard Obeng led the team through a light training session on Tuesday, which included shooting drills, as the players fine-tuned their preparations for Wednesday’s crucial encounter.
Fourteen of the 15 players took part in the session, with Richard Ekwam the only absentee after picking up an injury during Ghana’s emphatic victory over Iraq.
The Black Challenge will now turn their attention to the USA, knowing that victory will secure a place in the quarter-finals and keep their hopes of winning the tournament alive.
